scope: Offline Linux race validation and build only; no provider guest creation or production mutation
verified_behaviors: Concurrent client creates serialize through provider acknowledgment
Independent SQLite clients cannot overlap pending create workflows
Cancelled queued creates send no provider request and reserve no capacity
Uncertain create remains fenced across database reopen despite spare active capacity
Repeated app create cannot bypass fence by choosing new sandbox ID
An existing running app can Connect while another create remains pending
Authoritative pause/delete and stale-response generation checks preserve capacity bounds
Scoped offline HTTP service follows frozen source app and cancels replaced generations
limitations: Local HTTP provider fixtures do not prove real worker burst behavior
Twelve allocated guests would not prove twelve busy-app throughput capacity
No production migration or worker-crash recovery acceptance is claimed
